No external fonts or CDNs. What’s included (overall) - Pages: index, about, services, programs, pricing, testimonials, book, contact - Local assets: assets/img/hero.svg, assets/img/avatar.svg, assets/img/pattern.svg - Subtle JS: mobile nav, smooth scroll, FAQ accordion, basic form validation hints Placeholders to customize - {{BUSINESS_NAME}} - {{TAGLINE}} - {{COACH_NAME}} - {{CREDENTIALS}} - {{PHONE}} - {{EMAIL}} - {{ADDRESS}} - {{CITY}} - {{STATE}} - {{ZIP}} - {{HOURS}} - {{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}} - {{PRIMARY_CTA_URL}} Where placeholders appear - H1 headings on pages (e.g., “Contact {{BUSINESS_NAME}}”, “Book a session with {{COACH_NAME}}, {{CREDENTIALS}}”). - Navigation primary CTA button (label + URL). - Contact details (phone, email, address, hours) in header top bar and footer. Brand identity - The default copy references a fictional brand voice called “Brighter Tides Wellness.” Replace or keep as a flavor layer. Key spots (H1, nav CTA, contact info) are wired to placeholders to make swapping fast. Quick start 1) Open the files and replace placeholders with your details (use a global find/replace). 2) Put your logo or keep the playful badge block. Update colors in :root CSS variables. 3) Replace the three SVGs in assets/img with your own artwork if desired. 4) Open index.html in a browser or serve locally. Local development - Use any static server, for example: Python: `python3 -m http.server 4000` Node: `npx serve .` - Then visit http://localhost:4000 Accessibility & semantics - Logical heading order, aria-expanded/aria-controls for accordions. - Form inputs with labels and aria-invalid on error. - High-contrast palette; large hit targets. Forms - Client-side validation is hint-level only; add your backend. - newsletter/contact/booking forms use `novalidate` with JS to display inline errors. SEO - Unique titles and meta descriptions per page. - Semantic sections and descriptive link text. - Add your favicon set if needed (current favicon uses the local pattern.svg). Performance - System fonts only; minimal JS. - SVG artwork and lightweight gradients. Customization tips - Colors: edit CSS variables (—teal, —sand, —off, —accent) at the top of each page or move to a shared stylesheet. - Shapes: replace pattern.svg to instantly change the vibe. - Voice: update headlines and microcopy while keeping the friendly, premium tone. License & usage - This template is provided as-is for your projects. Replace placeholder content and adapt to your brand. Changelog - 2026-02-15: Initial release.
